text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp had begun. With the Ibis Summer Dash coming up, it would also serve as a final tune-up period for Calstone Light O.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There was a straight road nearby, wasn't there!
I could see it from inside the bus!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Let's do our final tune-up for the Ibis Summer Dash over there!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
My, that sounds lovely.
I agree with that as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Godolphin Barb-san!
Trainer, please turn the screen
toward us.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Virtual space has its perks, but as an Umamusume, you really want to run while feeling the natural breeze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you're wondering why Godolphin Barb's voice
is coming out of a smartphone—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
And then you caught up to the train and passed it?
That's amazing, Light O-chan!
I wish I could've seen it too~...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I wanted to watch the Aoi Stakes in person too.
Not just as a VR recreation from video footage...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Is it not possible to go outside the Umulator?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, we lack physical forms,
so that simply won't be possible...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Buuut! We might still be able to look outside from this space.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Yes. —Ah, looks like they just arrived.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Nǐ hǎo!
Oh, everyone involved is here.
Looks like we can get to work right away, Dia."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Right O-san's Trainer.
May I please borrow your smartphone?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will install the Umalator satellite app
onto Trainer's smartphone!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You won't be able to enter the virtual space itself, but you'll be able to access the Three Goddesses through the app!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Niigata—let's go to the Ibis Summer Dash
together, Godolphin Barb!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, I can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like this summer training camp
is going to be livelier than ever.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well then...
choice_data_list: (That's... Tachyon. So she came after all.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon—she was supposed to be
recovering after suffering an injury
before the Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I assumed she wouldn't be participating in the training camp,
but could her comeback be near?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all, it's time for Calstone Light O's
final adjustments ahead of the Ibis Summer Dash!
